thread:
Alex Rivera: quick RFC follow-up on admission boundaries. we need a low-risk rollout for abuse-informed prioritization.
Nora Singh: current problem: every admit RPC calls AbuseService and spikes latency when scaled.
Priya Kapoor: idea: add a tiny enum `PriorityHint` to Admit proto and put raw continuous scores in a sidecar Lookup service.
Dan Miller: tradeoff: proto churn vs RPC cost. if hint covers 90% of cases we avoid hot-path rpcs.
Alex Rivera: local bench: hint-only path cuts p99 by ~2ms. good win.
RateBot: canary queued: admit-priority-hint-500. will report fairness and latency.
Nora Singh: ops concerns: caching TTL in sidecar creates transient stale priority. recommend probation tokens for short windows.
Priya Kapoor: safety: AdmitRequest must not fail when Lookup is down. fallback to PH_LOW and emit metric `admit.lookup_down`.
Dan Miller: also add `X-Priority-Source` header when proxy sets a hint (cached|lookup|operator) for audit.
Alex Rivera: runtime decision: admission returns admitted:true/false + suggested_priority. serving layer does deterministic normalization.
EngInfraBot: tasks created ENG-3620 (proto: add PriorityHint), ENG-3621 (abuse-lookup-sidecar).
Alex Rivera: decision: hybrid path. Alex to draft RFC PR; Priya to spec sidecar; Nora will run canary and monitor. Thanks everyone.
